---
title: Integration and Accumulation
description: Build integrals from accumulation, connect them to derivatives, and use them responsibly.
page_type: unit
---

Integration turns local rates into global change. This unit develops the definite
integral as a limit of sums, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, techniques for
antiderivatives, and model-based applications.

## Unit outcomes

- explain what an integral accumulates and how units propagate;
- state and apply the hypotheses of the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus;
- select a technique from structure rather than pattern matching alone;
- estimate, compute, interpret, and independently verify definite integrals.

Begin with [Integrals](integrals.qmd).
